description: Source code for the ExitInterview document class and related functions in the ERPNext HR module, handling exit interview validation, email notifications, and status updates.

classes.name: ExitInterview
classes.description: Represents an exit interview document with validation, email notification, and status update methods.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the exit interview, including relieving date, duplicates, and email setup.

methods.name: validate_relieving_date
methods.description: Checks if the employee's relieving date is set.

methods.name: validate_duplicate_interview
methods.description: Ensures no duplicate exit interview exists for the employee.

methods.name: set_employee_email
methods.description: Sets the email address for the employee.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Handles actions when the exit interview is submitted, including status validation.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Handles actions when the exit interview is canceled.

methods.name: update_interview_date_in_employee
methods.description: Updates the 'held_on' date in the Employee record based on interview status.
